{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in the second mission of the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== The story of this map happens after [[Backyard Beginnings]]. [[Clive]], [[Isaak]] and [[Ruthie]] are preparing to fight against the [[Decoy]], [[Soccer Speedy]] and [[Whistle]] in a new soccer court, with the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] acting as the referees yet again. The match starts once a whistle is heard. While the match is going on, the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] discuss their performance and if they can beat the team. [[Clive]] runs up to the goal but is stopped by [[Felipe]], ending the cutscene. Once the match starts, similarly to the last map, the trio simply discusses the match and talks between each other. ==Cutscene== [[File:Adidas Event Cutscene 2|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays when the timer counts down to 0:00 before the game starts. The player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when it begins. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
A soccer court is shown with six players on it and two referees. The players are [[Clive]], [[Ruthie]] and [[Isaak]] playing against the [[Soccer Speedy]], [[Decoy]] and [[Whistle]], with the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] as referees. The match starts once a whistle is heard. While the match is going on, the [[Dispatcher]] mentions how good the main trio is. The [[Commander]] however is unsure if they can beat the other team. [[Clive]] then is shown running and stopping when [[Felipe]] blocks him.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:AdidasMission2Opening.ogg|300px]]
''The screen shows a soccer ball court with the [[Whistle]], [[Soccer Speedy]], [[Decoy]], [[Ruthie]], [[Clive]] and [[Isaak]] plying against each other. The [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] seemingly act as referees.'' {{Color|Molten|Clive}}: Who's up next? ''A whistle is heard and the match starts.'' ''[[Clive]] kicks the ball to [[Ruthie]], who then redirects it [[Isaak]]. It is then redirected back to [[Clive]].'' ''Camera now shows the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]].'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Okay, I'll admit it! They're pretty good! {{Color|Commander}}: Eh. I don't know if they can beat this team. ''Camera now shows [[Clive]] who is stopped by [[Felipe]].'' {{Color|Molten|Clive}}: Woah...
